rules.red_rule: encoded OR linear R / (R + G + B) < 0.8 (vj-themes.js isSaturatedRed); every colour that pulses, chases, kicks or is a laser keeps both at or under 0.78; a held pin at or under 0.80
rules.red_sector: OKLCh hue 345..360..30 never above chroma 0.12 in anything that moves (gradient samples included)
rules.strand: 2 stops dEOK 0.16-0.32 (3 stops 0.10-0.30 each), hue gap <= 66 on one fixture, chroma within 0.08, linear midpoint chroma >= 0.07
rules.kick: kick L >= base L + 0.15; kick and highlight >= 0.10 apart, kick >= 0.15 from white, highlight >= 0.10 from white, kick chroma >= 0.08, kick >= 0.20 from base
rules.ladder: kick and highlight luminance ratio >= 0.80 (kick.js equal_luma 0.35 allows 0.65; 0.80 keeps a re-strike under the limiter threshold on a big area)
rules.decay: every kick colour crossfades back to its own cell colour in linear rgb with midpoint chroma >= 0.06
rules.amber: no kick or highlight at OKLCh hue 40-105 unless the palette is declared warm (Molten only)
rules.gradients: adjacent stops dEOK 0.08-0.30 (OKLCh middles inserted above 0.28), hue gap <= 80, no lightness dip, chroma never under 0.07 or half the weaker end, 32 samples each checked for red
rules.heads: rest not 1, 2, 11, 12 or 13; lift one slot, a clean short way, not much darker (kick.js nearestShortSlot rules), within 45 degrees of a kick colour (or the partner family, heads-only areas)
rules.lasers: L >= 0.58, red-safe, the fan pair within 80 degrees

palettes.kick_rules: WHITE KICK: the dealt area goes to the palette white #f8f7f0 and decays over the linger; heads punch dimmer and shutter on their slot (no wheel move). COLOUR KICK: each LED cell lifts inside the palette: base cells to #8eed6b (L +0.24), partner cells to #bce2cc; the area keeps its gradient phase and jumps it a quarter cycle. Heads rest on slot 5 green and step to slot 4 lime (with the LEDs), back on the release. RE-STRIKE: the other ladder colour at equal luminance (ratio 0.97) plus the comb flip; never a bright/dark swing, never an equal-L swap alone. Never: slot 1, 11 or 12, a nearest-slot snap, or a colour from outside this palette.
palettes.why_it_works: A near-grey bed makes the one green read as poison light: the strand runs bone to green, the kick lifts bone to hive green and green to pale bone-mint. The heads kick green to lime. The ring ladder keeps a little warmth in the grey so it does not go dead on camera.
changes: kick hive green is 0.22 from white; the bone ladder keeps a little warmth so it does not go dead on camera
